references.text: The Lord's hand against His people when they are disobedient, with enemies ruling over them
The curses that would come upon Israel if they did not obey the voice of the Lord, as the Lord had said
The Lord would let them be defeated before their enemies, just as it happened in the time of the Judges
Joshua's warning that the Lord would bring disaster upon them if they broke the covenant, as He had promised
The Lord's hand was against the Philistines, an example of God's intervention in Israel's wars
The Lord's wrath against His people and how He gave them into the hands of the nations, summarizing the time of the Judges
When the people were rebellious, the Lord became their enemy and fought against them
The Lord did what He had determined and fulfilled His word that He had proclaimed from ancient times
